subject: AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM intro — next steps for Gridlytics opportunity
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan@gridlytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick — marketplace path for our procurement team

Camila / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Gridlytics asked whether we can appear on the AWS Marketplace (SaaS listing) so they can route purchase through their existing enterprise agreements. Can Redwood be listed? If so, what do you need from us to speed the process?

Jordan
Director of Platform
Gridlytics

---
Attachment: Gridlytics_RFP_Summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick — marketplace path for our procurement team

Jordan — appreciate the heads up. Short answer: yes, AWS Marketplace is usually the fastest path for procurement. We need to get through AWS co-sell registration (ACE) and a PDM/PSM intro so the AWS account team can queue the listing.

Immediate asks from our side to move quickly:
- Gridlytics: completed AWS vendor intake (I can send the form) + company marketing blurb and logo.
- Redwood: marketplace listing metadata + pricing SKU draft (attached).

Marcus — looping you and Karthik to coordinate ACE registration and to get us an initial PDM contact at AWS. I can intro Jordan to AWS once we have the intake packet filled.

Next step: I’ll send the AWS intake form tonight; Jordan, can you have procurement take a first pass by EOD Thu?

Thanks,
Camila
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_AWS_Listing_Details.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick — marketplace path for our procurement team

Camila — I spoke with our channel ops. Two parallel tracks: ACE enrollment (partner registration + co-sell opt-in) and the Marketplace listing submission. ACE will surface a PDM/PSM — will try to get Sam Thorne (AWS PDM) to own the co-sell motion for Gridlytics because he covers mid-market ISVs in the west region.

Checklist I told ops we need to complete:
1) Vendor intake form (Gridlytics) -> Jordan
2) Technical listing spec (Redwood) -> Karthik
3) Pricing SKUs + sample invoice -> Camila
4) NDA / SOW if procurement asks -> Lauren

I’ll reach out to Sam directly and request an intro. ETA: intro by end of day tomorrow if he’s available.

Marcus
Senior Channel Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Thorne <sam.thorne@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Jordan Price <jordan@gridlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick — marketplace path for our procurement team

Thanks for the ping, Camila / Marcus — happy to help. I’m Sam Thorne (PDM for ISV co-sell, NA West). I’ve reviewed the initial brief Marcus shared. Next steps from AWS side:

- Camila: submit the ACE registration with co-sell opt-in (I’ll send the ACE link below).
- Gridlytics: confirm the buyer account ID and procurement contact; we’ll need that to attach the opportunity.
- AWS Marketplace team will validate the technical spec once the listing is submitted.

I can schedule a 30-minute sync today at 2pm PT to align PDM/PSM responsibilities. If that works for everyone, please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Sam Thorne
Partner Development Manager, AWS
aws-marketplace@amazon.com

Sam / Jordan — 2pm PT works for us. Calendar invite accepted.

Jordan: I attached the vendor intake form you asked for (Gridlytics_AWS_Req_Form.pdf). Can you have procurement fill and return it before the 2pm sync? If not, we’ll still run the sync but will need to tee up the buyer account ID afterward.

I also attached the DocuSign SOW template we use when procurement requests contract language — Lauren will lead any negotiations. After the sync Sam will own a PDM/PSM mapping and we'll open the ACE registration (I’ll submit the partner-side fields).

Quick asks for tomorrow’s sync (agenda):
- 5 min intros
- 10 min ACE/register steps + timeline
- 10 min Marketplace listing requirements (spec owner: Karthik)
- 5 min procurement questions + next steps

See you at 2pm.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
